title: gtregression 1.1.0
text: Added publication-ready flextable output default table format across package table functions, retaining gt tibble-style outputs appropriate. Added support unquoted option values common arguments, including model approaches output formats, users can write calls approach = logit format = flextable. Added adjust_for support adjusted multivariable workflows, including downstream regression plots combined regression plots. Added adjusted-variable notes regression plots combined regression plots. Added optional model-fit statistics uni_reg() multi_reg() via model_stats = TRUE, AIC, BIC, log-likelihood, deviance, pseudo R-squared, linear-model R-squared, model N stored $model_stats. Added approach = "firth" / approach = firth Firth penalized logistic regression uni_reg(), multi_reg(), stratified_uni_reg(), stratified_multi_reg(), tables compatibility regression plots forest plot helpers. Added data_endometrial, classic endometrial cancer dataset separation pattern, teaching testing Firth logistic regression. Added cox_reg() Cox proportional hazards regression using time, event, exposures, optional adjust_for, returning HR adjusted HR tables. Added surv_reg() parametric survival regression using time, event, exposures, optional adjust_for, selectable survival distribution, returning time-ratio tables. Added km_plot() Kaplan-Meier survival curves optional confidence intervals, censoring marks, log-rank p-values, number--risk tables. Added km_risk_table() standalone Kaplan-Meier risk tables requested follow-times, -risk, event, censored counts. Added rmst_table() restricted mean survival time summaries chosen follow-time, optional two-group RMST difference. Added surv_model_compare() comparing candidate parametric survival distributions AIC, BIC, log-likelihood, scale, events, N. Added plot_surv_fit() visually comparing observed Kaplan-Meier curves fitted parametric survival curves. Added surv_predict() model-based survival probability predictions fitted parametric survival regression models. Added survival_summary() Kaplan-Meier median survival summaries total N, events, censored counts, publication-style table outputs. Added survival_quantiles() Kaplan-Meier survival time quantiles, including event percentiles, corresponding survival probabilities, confidence intervals. Added survival_prob() Kaplan-Meier survival probabilities fixed follow-times, -risk, event, censored, confidence interval columns. Added logrank_test() formal comparison Kaplan-Meier survival curves, observed expected events plus formatted p-value output. Added check_ph() proportional hazards screening Cox models using Schoenfeld residual tests, flextable, gt, tibble outputs. Added plot_model_fit() visual model diagnostics fitted lm/glm models models stored uni_reg() multi_reg() outputs. Added mediation_analysis() regression-based mediation analysis formatted direct, indirect, total, proportion mediated tables. Added plot_mediation() drawing mediation path diagram mediation_analysis() outputs. Added data_diabetes_mediation, health-related diabetes teaching dataset practicing obesity, glucose, diabetes mediation workflows. Added automatic support variable label attributes, including labels set labelled::var_label(), across descriptive, regression, stratified, merged, plotted, forest-style outputs. Added formatted display outputs diagnostic review functions including dissect(), select_models(), interaction_models(), identify_confounder(). Added Mantel-Haenszel comparison support identify_confounder() support confounding assessment alongside crude adjusted model comparisons. Added manual case-study scripts dev/manual-tests/ real-time testing logistic, linear, log-binomial, robust Poisson, Poisson, negative binomial, Cox, parametric survival, Firth, mediation workflows.
